programme.title: Capítulo 103
programme.desc: Roberta finds out about Diego and Paola dating. Mia runs away from school and goes to stay with Alma. Meanwhile, Miguel searches for Mia.

programme.title: Capítulo 104
programme.desc: Giovanni is angry that Miguel goes to look for Mia. Roberta finds Mia at Alma's and gets upset. Miguel finds Mia at Alma's and they kiss; they leave and spend the day together.

programme.title: Capítulo 105
programme.desc: Before returning to school, Miguel tells Mia that they have to forget everything that happened between them and they can't begin dating. However, Miguel ends his relationship with Julieta.

programme.title: Capítulo 106
programme.desc: Due to jealousy, Roberta tells her mom to choose her or Mía. Miguel decides to tell Mía he has feelings for her; they decide to keep their relationship secret.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Six teenagers with different lives and personalities attend a prominent private school with only one thing in common: their vocation and passion for music.

programme.title: Capítulo 108
programme.desc: When Alma comes to Franco's house, she finds him drunk; he kisses her. Mia tells Giovanni the truth of how she feels and breaks up with him.

programme.title: Capítulo 109
programme.desc: Valeria warns Alma to stay away from Franco. After Mia and Miguel kiss, she runs away. However; she returns, apologizes, and ask him to make her a woman.

programme.title: Capítulo 110
programme.desc: Celina quits the band and asks Mia to take her place. Miguel takes Mia to her house to reconcile with her father.

programme.title: Capítulo 111
programme.desc: Teo tells Miguel he passed the test given by the Lodge members and it's all thanks to his girlfriend, Roberta. Franco tells Mia about her mom.

programme.title: Capítulo 112
programme.desc: Franco tells Miguel that Mia has been happier and more mature since she fell in love. Carlo, Mia's uncle comes to visit; him along with Franco, Valeria, Alma, Mia, and Miguel spend the weekend together.

Entonces, Ludovico quiso dormir en la alacena, pero una gotera lo moja y fue a la azotea a cerrar las llaves de paso, pero (cree que) se queda atrapado.

programme.desc: A Ludovico y Federica les llega una carta diciéndoles que su matrimonio no es válido, y esto debido a que no se entiende la firma de Ludovico.

programme.title: Un día de vida
programme.desc: En el laboratorio de diagnóstico le dicen a Ludovico que a Federica le quedan pocas horas de vida y para darle más tiempo, evitaría un disgusto. Por su parte, Federica lee en una revista que si un esposo trata muy bien a su mujer significa que planea abandonarle.

programme.title: Buenos padres
programme.desc: Gracias a Ludovico, los padres de un compañero de Ludoviquito hacen una visita a su casa para conocerlos, por lo que los P.Luche deben actuar más decentemente para impresionarlos.

programme.title: Reality show
programme.desc: Un productor descubre a los P. Luche (incluyendo Excelsa) y los invita a participar en un programa similar a Big Brother, el cual se realizaría en la propia casa de la familia con muchas cámaras vigilándolos, y el ganador recibirá un millón de pesos.

programme.title: Ahorros de Navidad

programme.title: Tacos veganos

programme.desc: Frankie se entera de que un famoso director está interesado en uno de sus guiones. Los López Pérez reciben una orden de desalojo. Germán decide irse a Estados Unidos tras una decepción amorosa.

programme.title: El regreso de Luis
programme.desc: Luis le pide a Silvia que sea su novia, Pedro lo convence de ser mejor persona y así conseguir su amor. Los López Pérez regresan a vivir al edificio y Germán les tiene a todos una sorpresa.

programme.title: Primera cita
programme.desc: Magdalena es la nueva jefa de seguridad y, debido a los robos en el edificio, instala cámaras con la ayuda de Germán. Silvita y Luisito tienen su primera cita.

programme.title: El cumple de Silvia
programme.desc: Silvia cumple años y aconsejan a Luis que no la felicite para llamar su atención. Los López Pérez no encuentran a Morris por ningún lado y sospechan que se ha ido de la casa.

programme.title: Luis pobretón
programme.desc: Luis se ha quedado sin trabajo, por lo que buscará una nueva actividad para invitar a Silvia a salir. Por otro lado, Luismi ha llegado solo al edificio.

programme.title: La novia de Pedro
programme.desc: Pedro invita a salir a Cris, la mejor amiga de Silvia, y organiza una cita doble con Luis y Silvita. La alcaldía instala una cámara de fotomultas y los flashazos apuntan directo al edificio.

programme.title: En una relación
programme.desc: Después de un tiempo de salir juntos, Luis le pregunta a Silvia qué son y quiere que se decida de una vez. La alcaldía instala lámparas de led en el alumbrado público y la no deja dormir a los vecinos.

programme.title: Beso fallido
programme.desc: Luis invita a Silvia a ver una película a su casa, pero Pedro interrumpirá su romántico momento, pues quiere recuperar su tele. Por otra parte, Arturo jugará póker con Germán, Jorjais y Benito.

programme.title: Las pantuflas de Luis
programme.desc: Luis y Pedro hacen una apuesta para saber si se dice pantuflas o pantunflas y le preguntarán a todos los vecinos. Lorena sospecha que Benito está molesto por su nuevo galán.

programme.title: Segundo aire
programme.desc: Germán descubre que en el edificio hay una plaga de cucarachas, por lo que Magdalena le ordena que haga una inspección en su departamento.

programme.title: Número equivocado
programme.desc: Alguien grafiteó la fachada del edificio. Para retirarlo, Germán cambia el número de la entrada. ¿Recibirá Luis el paquete que espera? ¿Acudirán a pintar el departamento de Lorena?

programme.title: Magdalena y la tercera edad
programme.desc: Magdalena descubre que las personas de tercera edad recibirán tarjetas de ayuda. La familia López Pérez intenta obtener el beneficio. A Luis le molesta que Benito tenga un auto nuevo.

programme.title: Cásate conmigo
programme.desc: Comienza una guerra tras la pelea entre Silvia y Luis, sin embargo él le pide matrimonio. Lorena le pide a Germán que arregle una mesa.

programme.title: La boda
programme.desc: Luis y Silvia anuncian su boda y los vecinos los convencerán para que se casen en el edificio y ayudarán a los preparativos.

programme.title: Vecinos ruidosos
programme.desc: Los vecinos se quejan de los ruidos que vienen del departamento de Luis y Silvita, Germán intenta reparar la tubería de Lorena y los López Pérez sufren de comezón.

programme.title: Frankie regresa
programme.desc: Frankie regresa a vivir al edificio, con Lorena y con Benito, pero con la condición de que encuentre trabajo. Pero, en vez de eso, escribirá una nueva película.

programme.title: La llegada de Vanesa
programme.desc: Vanesa vuelve al edificio para visitar a los Vecinos y ponerse al corriente. Benito invita a su novia a "ver pelis" en el departamento, al enterarse de que sus papás saldrán.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: Alejandro returns home after a terrible accident to discover that he is married to Maria Jose, a poor, innocent girl who was deceived by Alejandro's brother Bruno. Bruno used Alejandro's name to marry Maria Jose, soon after he sent to kill his brother in hopes that Maria Jose would inherit Alejandro's fortune. But when Maria Jose arrives at the mansion she realizes that Bruno lied to her and used her. She is also scared when Alejandro is found alive and returns home. Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Cyanide Bombs, New CWD Research, and F%ck Data Centers | The News Show Ep. 882 - 12 - 882
programme.desc: Steven Rinella and the MeatEater crew discuss: New research about CWD that you really need to hear; bear spray vs. pistols; are cyanide bombs really bombs?; wolves in the Greater Yellowstone Area; how the Alaskan Arctic might be getting a data center, plus the rapid spread of data centers across the country; and more.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Arizona Jaguars, CWD Elk, and a New One-Buck Limit for Michigan Hunters | The News Show Ep. 879 - 12 - 879
programme.desc: Steven Rinella and the MeatEater crew discuss: Steve's new baby mouse; Corner Crossing updates; the endangered jaguar hanging out in Arizona; live sonar for billfish and the end of integrity in fishing; Louisiana's National Forest land transfer; the first ever detection of CWD in Wyoming's largest elk herd; South Dakota sets an unprecedented elk hunting management plan; Michigan's major buck hunting rule changes; and more.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Who Will Save the Columbia River's Salmon? | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 829 - 12 - 829
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with Donella Miller and Doug Hatch of the Columbia River Inter-Tribal Fish Commission (CRITFC), Brody Henderson, Janis Putelis, Seth Morris, Phil Taylor, and Corinne Schneider. Topics discussed: The Six Sovereigns restoration initiative of the Columbia River basin; having a holistic philosophy and viewing fish as a forever fixture; salmon runs; steelhead reconditioning; chinook recovery; sockeye and coho reintroduction; lamprey restoration; the sea lion crisis; and more. Feel free to donate to the recovery effort here: https://critfc.org/donate/

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Moose Hunting in North Dakota, Catfish Regs, and A Bigfoot Family | The News Show Ep. 862 - 12 - 862
programme.desc: Steven Rinella and the MeatEater crew discuss: Randall and Phil's film from BuckFest and The Big Buck Hunter Championship; Jordan Sillar's Blood Trails, Season 2 drops; a Land Access Initiative update; Etsy bans fur; how birding improves your brain health; South Dakota becomes the first state to remove suppressors from the list of controlled weapons; Pennsylvania changes to blue and flathead catfish regulations; Bigfoot sightings in Ohio; and more.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Restoring Alaska's Wild Buffalo | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 823 - 12 - 823
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks withTom Seaton, lead biologist for the Alaska Department of Fish and Game Wood Bison Restoration Project. Steven Rinella talks withTom Seaton, lead biologist for the Alaska Department of Fish and Game Wood Bison Restoration Project. Topics discussed: Where and when buffalo are considered wildlife and not; how to bring wild buffalo to Alaska; how much habitat is really there for wild buffalo?; is there truly a conflict between agriculture and and bison, or is it just perceived?; the brucellosis red herring; what's wood bison?; when you end up with fewer animals alive than you introduced; how easy it is for bison to drown; the challenges to reintroduction; and more.

To cap off the hunt, Steve cooks a batch of venison ribs braised in a Dutch oven buried beneath hot coals.

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It (Boo York City)
programme.desc: The Big Apple spits out a worm, Trump attacks California’s elections, and Spencer Pratt packs up his dreams of mayoral stardom. This week, Michael Urie lies down on Lovett’s couch and analyzes his feelings about Harrison Ford; Kel Cripe lays out a Pride month's worth of regulations in They/Them’s the Rules, and we put the show to rest with a nice warm cup of Second Thoughts.

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It (Scum Like It Hot)
programme.desc: It’s Part 1 of our Lovett or Leave It Pride Show Extravaganza! This week, World Cup fans taste America and demand unlimited refills, Trump wants us to chug his Iran Kool-Aid, and D.C. bellies up to the bar for this summer’s trendiest algae cocktail. Hollywood legend Bruce Vilanch gives a gay side eye to early LGBTQ moments in film, while Myki Meeks decides which 2026 Pride Merch items should sashay away. And we taste the rainbow with a very gay round of I Don’t Care, I Lovett.

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It (The Pride Will Continue Until Morale Improves)
programme.desc: It’s Part 2 of our Lovett or Leave It Pride Show Extravaganza! This week, Lovett celebrates Nuclear Family Month, Cats: The Jellicle Ball, and Rosie O’Donnell’s incredible facelift. Meanwhile, Ashley Ray and Brendan Scannell crown America’s Top Ally. Atsuko Okatsuka joins us as we burn our hands on Hot Takes about polyamory, bitchy gays, and forcing drag queens to do the splits, and the Second Thoughts library is open as we read Lovett to filth.

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It (The Pool is Always Greener)
programme.desc: JD Vance treads water on Iran, D.C. swan dives into Reflecting Pool chaos, and Trump lifts a glass to his brand-new Air Force One. This week, Matt Hamilton stops by to discuss local journalism, the L.A. mayoral race, and, of course, a plague of fire rats. Ali Siddiq and Ify Nwadiwe find out if Father really does know best with a round of Would You Rather?, and we have regrets like we’ve never had them before when we share our many, many Second Thoughts.

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It (New York Sees Red)
programme.desc: Mamdani's candidates win big in New York. Pesticides win big at the Supreme Court. And we all win when John Stamos stops by to talk Beach Boys, Full House, and why his dad finally let him quit flipping burgers. Then Jodie-Turner Smith waxes philosophical about aliens, accents, Michael Fassbender, and a gripping defense of toe shoes, courtesy of the Egg of Truth. And don’t worry, baby: we have plenty of Second Thoughts to go around.

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It (The Doctor is In…voking the Fifth)
programme.desc: Anthony Fauci gives Republicans the silent treatment, Mitch McConnell somehow says even less, and Joe Biden overshares enough for both of them. Daveed Diggs stops by to talk supervillains and elaborate musical contraptions, then we get just dumb enough with the great Anthony Michael Hall. The Egg of Truth turns up the heat but forgets to turn it off, and we decide if we regret that in a round of Second Thoughts.

programme.title: What a Day (Trump's Presidential Payday)
programme.desc:
About a month ago, the Antwerp World Diamond Center, which deals with a large percentage of the world’s diamonds, made Donald Trump a very special gift purportedly for America’s 250th birthday. Then, just last week, the Trump Administration coincidentally exempted natural diamonds from its new sweeping global tariffs. Not a great look. It’s no secret that the Trump Administration is steeped in deals aimed at getting the President, his family, and his political organizations paid. As the Wall Street Journal reported, Trump is routinely asking for cash from companies and donors so he can build his ballroom or future design projects. The funnel of money aimed at this White House can be almost overwhelming. So what can we do about it? We spoke to Amanda Carpenter, a writer and editor at Protect Democracy, who has some ideas.
And in headlines, July is on track to become the hottest month on record for the entire United States, about 60,000 migrants crossed from Morocco into Spain’s tiny Ceuta territory in just 24 hours, and oil companies are profiting from the Iran war and the rising cost of gas.

programme.title: Offline with Jon Favreau (The Journalist Who Let AI Run Her Life For a Year)
programme.desc: What happens when you turn your entire life over to AI for a year? Could it take over your emails or learn to mow your lawn? Would it replace your doctor or even your partner? Tech journalist Joanna Stern joins Offline to talk about her new book , I Am Not a Robot, where she embarked on that experiment, integrating AI into (almost) every aspect of her life for 365 days. She and Jon discuss what she learned about cancer treatment when she asked it to review her mammograms, what the experiment taught her about where AI may be most likely to displace workers, and why it left her thinking that AI regulation should begin at the local level.

programme.title: Pod Save America (Trump's Wars Are Bankrupting America)
programme.desc: The White House doubles down on both of Trump's wars — the war against Iran and his trade war — sending Pete Hegseth to the Hill to request a $70 billion cash infusion for the Pentagon and imposing new tariffs on Canadian imports and prescription drugs. Jon and Dan discuss how Democrats should approach the administration's funding request, how voters — especially MAGA Republicans — are reacting to Trump's moves, and the president's warning to Americans that they "can't fight" the construction of new data centers in their communities. Then, the guys break down a series of new polls that show the Democrats carrying a big lead into November, the "fight to the death" at the DNC Rules and Bylaws Committee to determine which state will lead off the 2028 Democratic presidential primary, and a new video showing the extent of Trump's Oval Office renovations. Then, Dan talks to former White House communications director Jen Palmieri about her new series, "Long Play," on winning back power in the South, available at youtube.com/@longplayseries or wherever you get your podcasts.

programme.title: Is It Magic Or Imagination
programme.desc: Darrin accuses Samantha of using witchcraft to win a slogan contest.

programme.title: Samantha Fights City Hall
programme.desc: Samantha fights to save a neighborhood park for the children.

programme.title: Moonshinin' Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are sent to Moonshine country in the Deep South to investigate problems between long-feuding bootlegging families, the Bartletts and the Catlins. Son, Bobby Dan Bartlett, who is injured trying to get a shipment of whiskey to market and Catlin daughter, Melinda, are in love, much to the displeasure of both families. Kris gets a job with the Catlins as a still master. Kelly gets a job with the Bartletts as a driver. Julie takes a job as a waitress at Joe's Diner. Bosley poses as a wealthy southerner trying to buy both families out. The Angels find that the shootings and hijackings have not been done by the families, but by a group headed by Max Lacy from New York. Lacy is trying to corner the whiskey market and gain political control of the state. The Angels are able to stop a gunfight between the family elders, Hawkshaw Bartlett and Bluford Catlin, and show them who the real culprits are. Max Lacy and his group are arrested. Hobby Dan and Melinda are happily reunited.

programme.title: Mr. Galaxy
programme.desc: Ron Gates, a young body builder, has several accidents while training with his manager, Artie Weaver, for the Mr. Galaxy title. The Angels are called in to find out who is trying to injure Ron. One of the suspects is the current Mr. Galaxy, Chuck Wilde. Another is Wilde's manager, Norman Powers. Another suspect is Danny Barr, owner of the arena with heavy underworld connections. At one time Ron Gates was a boxer who had a management contract with Barr, but who, after almost killing another boxer, quit boxing and took up body building. Barr has always been angry with Ron for walking out on him. Kris stays close to Ron to keep her eye on him. Kelly poses as a staff reporter for a leading body building magazine. Julie and Bosley are customers at the gym called Sportworld. Selena Hansen, the wife of the boxer Ron Gates almost killed, is also a suspect. Ron keeps away from all confrontations, and when Kris questions why he doesn't defend himself, he says he will never hit anyone again. Ron ultimately wins the Mr. Galaxy title. After several more brushes with death, the Angels discover it is Danny Barr who has been trying to get rid of Ron and he is taken into custody.

programme.title: Let Our Angel Live
programme.desc: The Angels and Bosley are hired to track down Joe Danworth, who walked off with $200,000 of his employer's money. Kelly and Bosley are waiting in their cars outside of his apartment building when he shows up. When Kelly approaches him with a gun, Danworth pulls a gun from his coat and fires. The bullet grazes the right side of Kelly's head. Bosley knocks Danworth out and Kelly is rushed to the hospital in a very serious condition. While Bosley, Kris and Julie are keeping vigil at the hospital, they sadly reminisce about Kelly. The doctor finally arrives and says they were able to treat her with heavy anti-coagulants and that she is going to be fine. Kelly wants to see them. Kris, Julie and Bosley all happily enter Kelly's room and she tells them that she thought that Charlie had been to visit her, but she couldn't stay awake. Bosley assures the Angels that Charlie had been there.

programme.title: Hellride
programme.desc: "Charlie's Angels," three bright, beautiful, athletic and police-trained private detectives become involved in a whirlwind of danger when they invest-igate the death of a woman stock car racer in the premiere episode of the new detective-drama series, "Charlie's Angels." Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and-Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant. In "Hellride," Sabrina becomes a race driver while Kelly, Jill and Bosley assume unusual disguises to learn why a pretty woman driver lost control of her car and died in a flaming wreck.

programme.title: The Mexican Connection
programme.desc: Jill, Kelly and Sabrina find themselves in the middle of a syndicate heroin war as "The Mexican Connection" airs on the new series, "Charlie's Angels." Charlie assigns the girls to find the saboteurs of a charter plane carrying cache of heroin. They travel south of the border to Mexico; their mission known only to the lone-surviving pilot of the ill-fated flight. Before they can sake their false identities credible, Charlie's Angels find themselves caught be-tween two warring heroin dealers. Finally, they are able to maneuver one of the drug kingpins into a federal police trap -- only to discover that the other one was working with them all along, under a false identity of his own! Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smyth star as the Angels Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Night of the Strangler
programme.desc: Kelly is a dead-ringer for a famous (murdered) photographer's model Night of the Strangler" on "Charlie's Angels." A series of rag doll stranglings brings Charlie's Angels (Kelly, Jill and Sabrina) into the case. Charlie counts on Kelly's resemblance to the first murdered girl to attract the killer. The wife of a well-known fashion designer is the next victim. Narrowing the possibilities, Charlie's Angels date the three most suspect men -- knowing full well one of them is a killer of great ingenuity and imagination. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels in Chains
programme.desc: The entire political and law enforcement, hierarchy of a rural town is involved in an extortion-murder scheme which preys on wealthy, young women as "Angels in Chains" airs on the new series, "Charlie's Angels." The half-sister of a missing girl prompts a Charlie's Angels investigation of a country prison farm and a nearby small town sheriff. Kelly and Jill deliberately get arrested for speeding. They are sentenced by a "kangaroo court" to unusually long terms at the nearby prison-farm. Once there, they discover that the sheriff, prison authorities, and the local County Manager are partners in an extortion-murder scheme. Wealthy young women without relatives are arrested and jailed on trumped-up violations. The women are virtually enslaved until they sign over all their assets in exchange for an "early release" and then killed. Those inquiring further are told that the missing girls have been paroled. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Target: Angels
programme.desc: Multiple attempts to kill Kelly, Jill and Sabrina force them to flee to the safety of Charlie's mansion in "Target Angels" on the new series "Charlie's Angels." In separate incidents, an unknown assassin tries to kill Angels Jill, Kelly and Sabrina. The pressure intensifies, forcing the girls to take to the only sure safety they know the compound where Charlie lives. Their anticipation at the prospect of seeing Charlie for the first time dims when they suddenly realize they have led the killers to their real target - Charlie! Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: The Killing Kind
programme.desc: Charlie calls angels Jill, Kelly and Sabrina together and tells them of the murder of the daughter of an old friend -- a young investigative reporter. In their quest to solve the killing, the three (Jill posing as a magazine photographer, Sabrina as a tennis instructor and Kelly as a guest) penetrate an exclusive hotel-resort. They soon learn that the owner, an underworld figure who, after turn-ing state's evidence and getting a new identity as part of the government's "witness relocation" program, has built a new criminal empire for himself. Their second discovery is that he intends to kill them. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.desc: Everything is topsy-turvy and henhouse hijinks ensue when one of the Douglas' hens is found to be laying square eggs! News of this kind gets around quickly, and the townsfolk all get in on the race to capitalize on the impressive novelty.

programme.title: An Old Fashioned Christmas
programme.desc: Oliver is absolutely determined to have a truly old-fashioned Christmas, including decorating his own farm-grown tree. But warm weather stands in the way and, he discovers, the residents of Hooterville aren't exactly as traditional as he thought.

programme.title: Never Trust A Little Old Lady
programme.desc: In true Hooterville fashion, Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that the town is vehemently split as to which weather reporter they trust. As debates rage over which forecast is correct, Oliver plants his tomato crop, hoping for the best.

programme.title: School Days
programme.desc: After another disastrous effort from Lisa in the kitchen, Oliver implores her to take a home economics class at the local high school. Before she knows it, Lisa is a fully enrolled student...the likes of which Hooterville High has never quite seen.

programme.title: His Honor
programme.desc: When the Hooterville City Council appoints Oliver (Eddie Albert) to judge the apple competition at the annual fair, he mistakes the honor for a real judgeship and prepares for his time on the bench! But a run-in with the real law clarifies matters.

programme.title: It's So Peaceful In The Country
programme.desc: Lisa visits Oliver's mother who is recovering from an illness. The doctor advises that she rest in a peaceful environment...and thinks that Hooterville sounds absolutely ideal! Of course, he doesn't know Hooterville, where peace is never�very close.

programme.title: Exodus To Bleedswell
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Hooterville has a still-valid contract to build war planes, he spearheads the opening of new government defense plant. But as chaos ensues, Oliver soon wonders if the move was a big mistake after all.

programme.title: It's Human To Be Humane
programme.desc: Lisa is appointed as head of Hooterville's new "Human Humane" committee. A perfect fit for animal-lover Lisa, and a relief from her boredom in the countryside, she soon has a menagerie of both farm and exotic animals living at Green Acres.

programme.title: Never Take Your Wife To A Convention
programme.desc: Oliver takes Lisa along to an agricultural convention. There, Lisa bonds with an ex-gangster couple, who insist upon teaching the Douglas's some of their shortcuts to successful farming. It turns out to be an offer that Oliver can not refuse.

programme.title: The Computer Age
programme.desc: Oliver champions agri-tech as way to increase productivity on the farm, but when a computer gives its assessment of the Douglas' marriage, Lisa (Eva Gabor) begins to question her union with Oliver. It's bits versus bytes in Green Acres!

programme.title: Lisa's Vegetable Garden
programme.desc: Determined to teach his spendthrift wife Lisa how to save money, Oliver insists that she learn about farming...by growing her own vegetables! In her own inimitable fashion, armed with useless pamphlets from Mr. Kimball, Lisa sets to tilling!

programme.title: The Saucer Season
programme.desc: When handyman Eb (Tom Lester) reports he has seen little green men piloting flying saucers, everyone in Hooterville takes him at his word�even the Air Force�and soon the Douglas farm becomes the Roswell of the greater Pixley area!

programme.title: Kimball Gets Fired
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) is distraught when her beloved Mr. Kimball, is fired as the county agricultural agent. Out of a job, Kimball (Alvy Moore) no longer has money enough to marry the lady-carpenter-in-waiting! But wait�did he even want to?

programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: Uncle Fester's Illness
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family Splurges

programme.title: The Addams Family In Court

programme.title: Amnesia In The Addams Family

programme.title: Macklemore – The BEN Tour: Live from Hollywood
programme.desc: GRAMMY® Award-winning rapper Macklemore brings The BEN Tour to a powerful close live from the Hollywood Palladium in Los Angeles, California. Blending his signature anthems like “Thrift Shop” and “Same Love” with new music from BEN, Macklemore celebrates authenticity, resilience, and community in an emotional finale filled with gratitude, energy, and connection.

programme.title: G-Eazy on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Multi-platinum rapper/producer G-Eazy sits down with Joel Madden to talk brotherhood, the early grind, and returning to the road after a six-year hiatus. From funny tangents (the philosophy of milkshakes) to reflective moments about not fitting in growing up, finding belonging in music, and dedicating part of his show to his late mom, Gerald shares why performing completes the art—and how a whirlwind London stop let him share the stage with his brother James. He also recalls his first runs back (including arena-scale crowds in India) and the community that’s formed around his all-black stage persona.

programme.title: Waterparks: FANDOM Live in the UK
programme.desc: A kinetic concert film captured at a sold-out O2 Academy Birmingham (Jan 2020), where Waterparks perform FANDOM through an alternate-universe lens. Executive producers Awsten Knight and Jawn Rocha fuse practical and special effects so every song looks the way it feels on stage—euphoric, chaotic, and intimate. Setlist highlights include crowd-igniting moments like “Dream Boy,” “High Definition,” “Dizzy,” and more, with circle pits, call-and-response, and fourth-wall breaks as the band records a live CD/DVD with the audience.

programme.title: Lost Evenings VI: Night 1 – Acoustic Duo with Matt Nasir
programme.desc: The opening night of Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim features an intimate acoustic set from Frank Turner and Matt Nasir. The performance blends heartfelt storytelling with stripped-down versions of fan favorites, including “Be More Kind,” “The Way I Tend to Be,” and a moving duet with KT Tunstall. Turner connects deeply with the audience while revisiting early songs and debuting new arrangements in this special evening of community, humor, and reflection.

programme.title: Tomorrow: Frost Children

programme.title: A Night out with the Backstreet Boys

programme.title: Matt Pryor of the Get Up Kids on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Host Joel Madden sits down with Matt Pryor, vocalist and guitarist of The Get Up Kids, for a conversation about van touring in the ’90s, being labeled “emo,” and how those early years shaped his approach to songwriting. Pryor also discusses the stories and reflections behind his new book, Red Letter Days, capturing life on the road, family, and creativity through the lens of an evolving music scene.

First, Kika Kim and Chanderland from XO Team visit an authentic Korean restaurant to enjoy spicy chicken, samgyeopsal, sushi, rice, and more. Then, explore a sweet and colorful purple food mukbang featuring chocolates, noodles, and snacks. Relax and savor every tasty moment of this special double-feature experience!

programme.title: ASMR Rainbow Dessert Picnic Mukbang in the Car
programme.desc: Join us for a colorful ASMR mukbang adventure! First, delight in a rainbow feast of Popping Boba, Jelly, Meringue Cookies, Pop Rocks, Sour Straws, Star Candy, and more. Then, enjoy a special car picnic with XO Team’s Alisha & Elsarca, sharing sweets, fruits, sushi rolls, and sandwiches. Experience the satisfying sounds and vibrant treats in this unique and delicious episode!

programme.title: GOLDEN BACHELOR
programme.desc: The guys put their matchmaking skills to the test, competing to see who is the best matchmaker in AMP's take on The Golden Bachelor.

programme.title: NEXT TOP MODEL
programme.desc: Previously on AMP's Next Top Model — with ChrisNxtDoor eliminated, five members of AMP compete in a fashion and modeling competition to see who has what it takes to be crowned Next Top Model.

programme.title: SHARK TANK PRANK
programme.desc: AMP transforms their warehouse into a fake marketing company called "Alternate Marketing Practices" and tries to convince a focus group of strangers to buy their new "experimental" products.

programme.title: BLACK JEOPARDY
programme.desc: AMP takes on the classic game show Jeopardy with a twist — every question centers around black culture, black history, and black trivia. Find out which guy knows the most about the "culture".

programme.title: THE PRICE AIN'T RIGHT
programme.desc: Welcome back to The Price Ain't Right — the only game show where you get punished for guessing the wrong price. The members of AMP play to guess the correct price, or face a punishment from the WHEEL OF MISFORTUNE.

programme.title: CONTAINER WARS
programme.desc: The guys hit the auction block looking for hidden treasure in old, abandoned storage units. Split into 3 teams with a $1000 budget each, they compete to flip their units for the most profit.

programme.title: $3M CAR COLLECTION
programme.desc: The AMP guys show off their combined $3,000,000 car collection. Some members have more cars than others, but with a total like that, you know every ride is worth the watch.

programme.title: GUESS THE COUNTRY
programme.desc: AMP puts their geographical knowledge to the test. Eight contestants from around the world step in, and the guys have to guess where each one is from using only the smallest clues.

programme.title: WORST PERSON EVER
programme.desc: How do you decide the Worst Person Ever? AMP brings in contestants with the most outrageous backstories and lets the guys vote on who takes the crown.

programme.title: GUESS THE STRIPPER
programme.desc: Six women walk into the AMP studio — one of them is a real stripper. The guys run through a series of challenges and questions to figure out which one.

programme.title: GUESS THE WHITE PERSON
programme.desc: This time, the guys are the contestants — hiding alongside one white person and trying to trick a jury of white people into picking the wrong one.

programme.title: GUESS THE IMPOSTER
programme.desc: Could you pick a celebrity out of a crowd if you'd never seen them before? AMP brings in strangers who've never heard of them and challenges the guys to impersonate each other — convincing total strangers they are who they claim to be.

programme.title: GUESS THE FELON
